description: This Dart source file defines the NotesRepository class responsible for managing note data. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, updating, deleting, and synchronizing notes between a local database and a remote API, handling connectivity checks and data serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: A repository class that provides methods for managing notes, including local storage operations and synchronization with a remote server.

methods.name: _parseTags
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of tags into a sorted list without duplicates.

methods.name: _encodeTags
methods.description: Encodes a list of tags into a, comma-separated string after trimming, deduplicating, and sorting.

methods.name: _fromRow
methods.description: Converts a database row into a Note object.

methods.name: _toRow
methods.description: Converts a Note object into a database-compatible map, marking it as dirty when specified.

methods.name: listLocal
methods.description: Retrieves a list of local notes with optional search and tag filters.

methods.name: getLocal
methods.description: Fetches a specific local note by its local ID.

methods.name: upsertLocal
methods.description: Saves a note locally and marks it as dirty for later synchronization.

methods.name: deleteLocal
methods.description: Soft-delete a note locally by marking it as deleted and updating the timestamp.

methods.name: syncBestEffort
methods.description: Attempts to synchronize dirty notes with the remote server, handling deletions and upserts, and checks for network connectivity.
